caption: The drawing consists of a large, central brown bell with a crack depicted near the bottom, representing the Liberty Bell. The bell is embroidered with the word "Liberty" in white on a red background around the crown. Behind the bell, there are two brown, diagonally crossed objects resembling staffs or poles. Green leaves and vine motifs are embroidered in the upper left, upper right, and lower left corners of the work. Large red text at the top reads "LOUDLY PEALED," and at the bottom, the words "the old Bell" are also in red, stylized letters. The years "1776" and "1876" are embroidered in green on either side of the bell, accompanied by a small red star under each date. The name "MARY. RIER." is embroidered at the very bottom in red capital letters. The composition is set on a beige or off-white textile background with a simple woven texture.
title: Sampler
